title: Origin of 13C NMR chemical shifts elucidated based on molecular orbital theory: paramagnetic contributions from orbital-to-orbital transitions for the pre-α, α, β, α-X, β-X and ipso-X effects, along with effects from characteristic bonds and groups
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1924-1940
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA05980H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Waro Nakanishi, Satoko Hayashi, Keigo Matsuzaki
The plain rules were formulated based on the MO theory to understand the origin and mechanisms leading to 13C NMR chemical shifts, by analyzing the pre-α, α and β effects and those from ethene, benzene, ethyne and the carbonyl group, for example.
